title: Exploring Enough: A Small Reward Near By, a Large One Down a Corridor, and Values That Start Optimistic

artifact.note: exploration in learning by trial: a grid with a small reward next to the start and a larger one at the end of a corridor; Q-learning that also counts how often each cell was visited; the return of the greedy policy it learns; with no random moves, with a tenth of the moves random, with half of them random, and with the table started at a value higher than any the task can give (optimistic), which makes every untried move look worth trying until it has been tried
